question: At the qualified R19 actual-108 state, how does cardinality-two phase-anchor sufficiency change as a balanced binary partition's circular transition count increases from 2 through 16, across eight frozen rotations and each phase-plus-one-derived-coordinate projection?
hypothesis: R19's contiguous-rotation support and parity failure reflect sensitivity to phase-bucket fragmentation. All rotations at low transition counts will reproduce full-five-coordinate membership, all rotations at sufficiently high transition counts will fail, and the eight-level spectrum will contain a single monotone boundary with no later restoration.

prior_evidence.observation: All eight balanced contiguous half-cycle rotations reproduced full-five-coordinate membership in all four derived-coordinate panels, while the balanced parity partition reproduced none; the full matrix had 32 exact matches, 324 correct triplets, zero split triplets, and 64 cross-entity collision pairs.

scope_statement: This changes one R19 dimension: binary phase-partition fragmentation, expressed as circular transition count. Actual-108 records, streams, seeds, cardinality two, balance, tuple width, four derived-coordinate panels, capacity, exact set equality, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, natural-language, or deployment claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.full_five_coordinate_control: Exact R19 actual-108 records represented by sorted exact sets of [phase_anchor,prefix0,prefix1,suffix0,suffix1].
arms_and_inputs.partition_formula: For level k in 1..8, phase index q=p-160, and rotation o in 0..7, bucket = floor((((q-o) mod 16)*k)/8) mod 2.

control_levels.k1: The eight R19 contiguous rotations; all four panels at every rotation must match full-five-coordinate membership.
control_levels.k8: Eight parity rotations, which are label complements or duplicates; no panel may match full-five-coordinate membership.

arms_and_inputs.partition_panel: Evaluate levels k=1..8, then offsets o=0..7, then [bucket,prefix0], [bucket,prefix1], [bucket,suffix0], [bucket,suffix1], for exactly 256 arms. Duplicate/complement projections remain declared controls and are not deduplicated. Every arm uses identical actual-108 records; no source byte is mutated.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, class cardinality, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Exact R6-R19 independent seeds; partition projection introduces no random draw.

controls: The local deterministic R19 probe must reproduce contiguous_rotation_invariant_parity_specific and its frozen exact metrics before R20 output.
The full five-coordinate control must reproduce nine correct triplets with zero splits and zero cross-entity collisions.
Level k=1 must exactly reproduce all eight R19 contiguous rotations and all 32 derived-coordinate membership matches.
Level k=8 must reproduce parity under every rotation and exactly zero of its 32 panels may match full-five-coordinate membership.
Every declared partition must place exactly eight phase indices in each bucket and have exactly 2*k circular transitions.
Every rotated bucket must reconstruct directly from the frozen formula; all 256 arms run once in declared order, including duplicate/complement controls.
Entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R19 probe reproduces its frozen classification and exact controls before R20 output.
All 256 projections are constructed from identical actual-108 records with exactly one binary phase bucket and one declared derived coordinate.
The level list is exactly 1..8 and rotations exactly 0..7; every partition is balanced 8/8 and has its declared circular transition count.
Every arm has frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 unordered entity pairs audited.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.monotone_fragmentation_boundary: Validity and controls pass; every level is either fully matching or zero matching, at least one non-control level is fully matching and at least one non-control level is zero matching, and no match occurs after the first zero-matching level.
classification_rules.immediate_fragmentation_failure: Validity and controls pass; level 1 is fully matching and every level 2..8 is zero matching.
classification_rules.rotation_or_coordinate_sensitive_fragmen: Validity and controls pass; at least one level 2..7 has between 1 and 31 matching panels.
classification_rules.nonmonotone_fragmentation: Validity and controls pass; no level is partial and at least one matching panel occurs after a zero-matching level.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass but none of the preceding scientific rules applies.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R19, full-five-coordinate, level-1, level-8, balance, transition-count, or rotation-construction control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the complete fixed 256-arm panel.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, arm-cardinality, projection, balance, transition-count, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on identity, R19 replication, full-five-coordinate control, level-1 control, level-8 control, partition construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R20 output begins, complete all 256 partition arms and frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not add levels or rotations, alter the partition formula, inspect alternate budgets, or change controls, metrics, thresholds, capacity, or classification after observing R20 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, level, rotation, partition formula, derived coordinate, budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R20 output.
